effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Huckmon] or [Sistermon] in its text and 1 such Tamer card or Option card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your white Digimon are played, gain 1 memory.
